assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational modern Arabic poetic achievement: myth, fracture and inherited forms are remade into a capacious, searching lyric language across a long career.
assessment.attribution: Credit Adonis alone for the sustained renovation of Arabic poetry and its modern imaginative horizon.
assessment.maturity: The representative books indicate an oeuvre of exceptional duration, formal coherence and continuing intellectual force.
uncertainties: Assessment depends substantially on translation and cannot fully measure the Arabic prosody and linguistic innovation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His densely patterned fiction makes memory, embodiment and visionary invention into an unusually ambitious metaphysical project.
assessment.attribution: Credit Cărtărescu alone for an oeuvre centered on the expansive imaginative architecture exemplified by Blinding and Solenoid.
assessment.maturity: The body of work appears sufficiently extensive and sustained to support recognition beyond either representative novel.
uncertainties: The relative force of the Romanian language and the full corpus are difficult to assess through translated access.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction of rare formal singularity, creating durable systems of landscape, recollection and mental image rather than conventional realism.
assessment.attribution: Credit Murnane alone for his distinctive remaking of the novel's relation to consciousness, place and imagined memory.
assessment.maturity: The representative works suggest a concentrated but deeply coherent lifelong project whose severity is part of its achievement.
uncertainties: The narrowness of the fictional territory may be judged differently from the evidence of the broader oeuvre.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her dreamlike narratives pursue an uncompromisingly original logic, unsettling psychology, space and causality with unusual imaginative independence.
assessment.attribution: Credit Can Xue alone for a sustained experimental fictional world rather than for a single work.
assessment.maturity: Frontier and Love in the New Millennium point to a mature, continuing project with recognizable formal commitments.
uncertainties: Translation may obscure the tonal and syntactic precision through which the Chinese prose achieves its effects.
Corpus-wide consistency requires fuller access than the representative works provide.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A highly distinctive multigenre oeuvre makes classical learning, lyric compression, narrative experiment and visual form mutually transformative.
assessment.attribution: Credit Carson alone for a body of work that has expanded the possibilities of contemporary lyric and hybrid literary writing.
assessment.maturity: The range from Autobiography of Red to Nox demonstrates sustained formal risk joined to intellectual depth.
uncertainties: The heterogeneous genres and forms make a single account of the oeuvre necessarily selective.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large polyphonic novels join Indigenous sovereignty, oral narration and ecological time in an ambitious reshaping of the contemporary novel.
assessment.attribution: Credit Wright alone for the novelistic achievement and the distinctive narrative forms of Carpentaria and The Swan Book.
assessment.maturity: The representative works indicate sustained imaginative scale and a body of work with major literary consequence.
uncertainties: The full relation of oral forms, English-language style and community-specific reference needs wider corpus knowledge.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her uncanny, exacting narrative voices make exclusion, coercive family relations and unstable belonging into a singular moral and formal terrain.
assessment.attribution: Credit NDiaye alone for a distinctive French-language oeuvre across fiction and drama.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels support a judgment of sustained command rather than an isolated accomplishment.
uncertainties: Translation can flatten the tonal ambiguity and verbal pressure central to the French prose.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A long fictional career uses layered voices and social worlds to recover divided histories with breadth, moral seriousness and narrative vitality.
assessment.attribution: Credit Hwang Sok-yong alone for the sustained Korean-language literary contribution represented by The Guest and Mater 2-10.
assessment.maturity: The long span and recurrent historical concerns suggest an oeuvre of substantial depth and durability.
uncertainties: Assessment of stylistic achievement is limited by translation and incomplete access to the Korean-language corpus.
